title: Clockwork release scheduler: deterministic RC signing and auto-notes pipeline
creator: Maya Ortega
description: Purpose: Harden and automate the weekly release train cut so that RC artifacts are deterministically fingerprinted, cryptographically signed, and accompanied by machine-generated release notes that surface critical changelog entries, regressions, and rollout gating decisions. Scope includes: (1) an RC fingerprinting algorithm that includes build metadata, test-suite signatures, and model artifact hashes; (2) a signing step integrated into our cut pipeline (GHA runner) that records the signer and key-id to S3/Release-Metadata; (3) an automated release-notes composer that pulls PR labels, linked issues, and test-failure summaries and generates a human-reviewable draft in Confluence and an md attachment to the release tag; (4) gating metadata emission for Canary/Canary2/LTS lanes consumed by the Console rollout controller for automated canary evaluation and rollback triggers.
acceptance_criteria: Every weekly RC tag created by the pipeline includes a deterministic fingerprint string that can be recomputed from build inputs.
Signed RC metadata (signer, key-id, signature) is attached to the release object and visible in the internal release dashboard.
Release-notes composer generates a draft with: PR summary, top-5 risk changes, failing test summaries, and LTS demarcation note. Draft must be editable in Confluence and attached to the release tag.
Console rollout controller can consume gating metadata to automatically schedule a canary cohort and evaluate success criteria within configured SLO windows.
Cross-check: recomputing fingerprint on a mirror machine yields identical fingerprint for same inputs in 100% of test runs.
Security review completed for signing flow and key usage and documented in the release playbook.
On-call runbook updated with verification steps and rollback checklist for RCs produced by this pipeline.
tasks: Design and doc deterministic fingerprint algorithm (include model artifact hashing strategy)
Implement fingerprint computation in buildpacks and expose as artifact:release-fingerprint.txt
Integrate GHA signing step using internal KMS wrapper; record signature to S3 release-metadata prefix
Build release-notes composer service (lambda) that queries PRs via GitHub GraphQL and test-results via CI API
Add a Confluence draft poster and md attachment flow to tag creation job
Emit gating metadata (cohort sizes, evaluation metrics, rollback thresholds) to release manifest
Add automated e2e test that simulates a cut and validates fingerprint/signature/notes emission
Update Console to display signer, fingerprint, and link to release notes draft
